about_the_game:
You wake up in an unknown land. Again. Use the experience from every past life and your ever-growing knowledge of alchemy to extend each life through a robust alchemical system. Explore, break through and uncover all the world has to offer in this minimalist RPG distilled down to its purest form

Features many unique zones, each with their own problems to solve, and plenty of secrets to be uncovered, ranging from actions becoming faster, to completely new paths opening up allowing you to reach more of the world.

A robust alchemical system is layered on top of everything, giving you good reason to go explore more, and a large variety of potion effects, each with their own use and purpose. Giving the feeling of a true alchemist and having a plethora of recipes for potions and other alchemical creations to overcome a huge range of obstacles.

A demo will be available soon, featuring the first zone of the game.
